integrity: Explicit proof with finite tests of word-closure generation; finite tests are not a general proof. Bibliographic completeness is not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Only unital full M_2 finite-field algebras. The global absolute-irreducible tuple polynomial has prior coverage in Reineke 2025; the distinguished claim is exact trace-fiber equidistribution for all prime powers, including characteristic two. The direct-product cutoff is a corollary, not claimed independently novel. No independent mathematical validation. For odd characteristic, fixed-trace uniformity follows by scalar translation from known unconditional counts; the characteristic-two refinement supplies the principal new content.
title: Trace-uniform generation of two-by-two matrix algebras over finite fields
